newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks close weaker on Dow Jones drop.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks close weaker on Dow Jones drop.

text.p: Manila shares retreated on Wednesday after two days of gains due to profit taking.

"There's profit taking on most stocks. Investors have been looking for direction but there is nothing new in the local front. Last night, Wall Street let them down," said Noel Reyes, head of research at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
The main index dropped by 11.13 points, or 0.34 percent, to 3,248.59 from Tuesday's close of 3,259.72 points.
"It looks like we are once again taking our cue from the Dow which closed lower on Tuesday," Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities & Securities Corp, said.
Helping to drag the index down was Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, one of the most actively traded stocks, which dropped by 20 pesos to 1,675 pesos, traders said.
Reyes added the market will move sideways for the rest of the week but the index will probably end higher than last Friday's close.
Cruz predicted a technical rebound before the week ends.
